meta_description: SB Painting & Decorating Solutions in Leeds. Interior and exterior painting, decorating, and wallpapering. Free quotes, fully insured. Call 07954 099423.
hero_subhead: From a single room refresh to a complete house repaint, we deliver quality finishes on time and within budget.
services_subhead: Whether it's a complete interior refresh, exterior weatherproofing, or specialist wallpapering, we handle every detail with care.

services.title: Interior Painting
services.desc: Walls, ceilings, woodwork, and feature walls. We prep thoroughly, use quality paints, and protect your furniture and floors. Most rooms completed in one to two days.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Cladding
services.desc: Fascias, soffits, doors, windows, and rendered surfaces. We work in all weathers and use masonry paints that resist Yorkshire's climate for years.

services.title: Wallpapering
services.desc: Pattern matching, feature walls, and textured finishes. We strip, prep, and hang with precision — seams and patterns are invisible.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery
services.desc: Skirting, architrave, doors, and fitted furniture. We sand, prime, and apply multiple coats of eggshell or gloss for a professional finish.

services.title: Colour Consultation
services.desc: Unsure about your palette? We advise on colour schemes, lighting, and finishes to suit your space and budget. Included free with every quote.

services.title: Commercial Decorating
services.desc: Offices, retail units, and rental properties. We work to tight schedules, minimise disruption, and leave sites clean and ready to let or occupy.

about_pullquote: We take pride in leaving every home looking exactly how the customer imagined.
about_para_1: SB Painting & Decorating Solutions has been transforming homes and businesses across Leeds since 2010. Founded by a painter with over 20 years' experience, we've built a reputation for meticulous preparation, colour expertise, and finishes that last. Every job, no matter the size, receives the same level of care and attention to detail.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we listen, we show up on time, and we leave your home spotless. We're fully insured, we use quality materials, and we never rush a job. Many of our clients have us back for new rooms or recommend us to their neighbours — that's the only marketing we need.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had the whole downstairs done — lounge, hall, kitchen. The lads were tidy, worked efficiently, and the finish is brilliant. Colour advice was spot on too. Honestly can't fault them. Already planning the upstairs!
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Needed the exterior painted before selling. They quoted within 48 hours, started when they said they would, and finished early. No mess, professional job. House sold within a fortnight. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Claire H.

reviews.text: Nightmare trying to find someone for wallpapering. SB came out, sorted a dodgy chimney breast, and hung three rooms of patterned paper perfectly. Seams are invisible. Great value, cracking workers.
reviews.author: David P.
